facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but bring earnings home within 90 days and convert most to dirhams.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: keep up to 70% of repatriated foreign income in an FX account.
facts.P3_local_gateways: CMI needs a commercial register entry and patente; unregistered freelancers can't use it.
facts.L1_registration: Auto-entrepreneur: register online, validate at Barid Al-Maghrib; services capped at MAD 200,000.
facts.L2_tax_id: A tax ID (IF) and ICE, issued automatically for auto-entrepreneurs.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Auto-entrepreneurs pay a final 1% of service turnover instead of income tax.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT; exported services are exempt; auto-entrepreneurs don't charge VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 09-08: notify the CNDP before collecting personal data on your website.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within 7 days of receiving the product.
facts.L7_incentives: 1% auto-entrepreneur tax, 70% currency retention, and VAT-free exported services.

watch_out.text: PayPal requires withdrawing to a Moroccan bank within 30 days.
Over MAD 80,000 a year from one client is taxed at 30%.
Leaving earnings on PayPal or Payoneer has been penalised; bring them home within 90 days.
